Word 转 Excel——离线、一张表进一张工作表、不上传Word to Excel offline — one table, values kept

四步，前两步与 Word→CSV 完全相同：`docx>html` 用 mammoth 读出文档（Heading 1 到 4 成 `h1` 到 `h4`、Title 与 Subtitle 成带 class 的 `h1` / `h2`、列表按 `ul` / `ol` / `li` 重开、内嵌图片成 data URI），净化后成一份自带样式表的 HTML，捞不到正文时再从 MHT altChunk 里恢复；`html>json` 取表格，**第一行给出键名**、其余行成记录，行列都限定在「这张表自己」的作用域内；`json>csv` 摊成表；`csv>xlsx` 写工作簿。真正决定产物的是最后一步：读 CSV 用 `raw: true`，SheetJS 的类型推断器碰不到数据，`00424` 不缩成 `424`、`2024-01-05` 不变成序列号；随后只有一道规则把该是数字的格子还回去——十进制形状、`String(Number(x)) === x` 逐字节回得来、有效数字不超过 15 位。16 位以上刻意留在文本，因为表格软件只渲染 15 位有效数字，卡号那一级编号一旦成数就会被读成 `4.11111111111111E+15`。仍是文本的格子再加公式护栏，并把数字格式钉成文本——写出的 `xl/styles.xml` 里那一格就是内置格式号 49。产物是一张工作表，表名沿用读取 CSV 时得到的那一个。两条要照实说的边界：文档里有两张表（含套在单元格里的那种）时，中间那步交出的是分组对象，CSV 那步只接受数组，整批报「JSON 内容必须是包含数据的数组才能转换为 CSV」；合并区被 `colspan` / `rowspan` 覆盖的位置不产生值，那一行的列会左移。全程离线、只有 storage 权限，净化之后仍会剥掉远程引用。Four steps, the first two identical to Word to CSV: `docx>html` reads the document with mammoth (Heading 1–4 become `h1`–`h4`, Title and Subtitle become classed `h1` / `h2`, lists reopen as `ul` / `ol` / `li`, embedded pictures arrive as data URIs), the result is sanitised and wrapped in the bundled stylesheet, and an empty pass falls back to the MHT altChunk; `html>json` lifts the table, **first row naming the keys**, later rows becoming records, all read inside a “this table only” scope; `json>csv` spreads it; `csv>xlsx` writes the workbook. The last step decides the artifact: the CSV is read with `raw: true`, so SheetJS’s inferrer never touches the data — `00424` does not shrink and `2024-01-05` does not become a serial — and one rule alone returns the number type: decimal shape, `String(Number(x)) === x` giving the exact characters back, at most 15 significant digits. Sixteen and above stay text deliberately, because a spreadsheet renders 15 significant digits and a card number turned into a value reads back as `4.11111111111111E+15`. Cells that remain text also get the formula guard and a pinned text number format — that cell carries the built-in format id 49 in the written `xl/styles.xml`. The output is a single worksheet, named whatever the CSV read produced. Two boundaries stated plainly: with two tables in the document (including one nested inside a cell) the middle step hands over a grouped object, the CSV step accepts arrays only, and the batch fails with “JSON must be an array containing data to convert to CSV”; and merged ranges are not expanded, so positions covered by `colspan` / `rowspan` produce no value and that row shifts left. Everything runs in this tab on the storage permission, and remote references are stripped after sanitising.

共 4 步，由扩展的路径搜索自动选出，中间产物不落盘。4 steps, chosen by the extension's own path search; intermediate results never touch the disk.

会保留什么What carries over

  • 数字只在字节能逐字回来时才是数字：`1727000000000` 可求和，`00424`、`1/2`、`2024-01-05` 保持原字符A value is a number only when its bytes come back exactly: `1727000000000` becomes summable while `00424`, `1/2` and `2024-01-05` stay as written
  • 16 位以上的编号留在文本，并钉住文本格式（写出的那一格是内置格式号 49）Identifiers of 16 digits or more stay text, pinned to a text number format (the written cell carries the built-in format id 49)
  • 列取所有记录键名的并集：某行缺的键留空格；比表头多出的单元格在取表那一步就被丢掉，所以后面几列不会错位Columns are the union of every record’s keys and a missing key is a blank cell, while cells beyond the header row are dropped at the table step, so later columns cannot shift
  • 一张表进一张工作表：中间那份 CSV 只有一个表，产物就是单 sheet，表名沿用读取结果One table, one worksheet: the intermediate CSV has a single table, so the sheet count is one and its name is whatever the read produced

如实说明的限制What it does not do

  • 两张表就撞闸：只要至少一张带数据行，交出的是分组对象，过不了「只接受数组」那一步——请一张表一个文档Two tables with data rows trip the gate: the grouped object cannot pass the arrays-only step, so keep one table per document
  • 段落、页眉页脚、脚注正文与批注不进工作簿；插入修订的文字与脚注引用标记会留在它们所在单元格的值里Paragraphs, headers and footers, footnote text and comments do not reach the workbook, while inserted revisions and footnote references stay inside the value of the cell carrying them
  • 合并区不展开，被覆盖的位置不产生值；嵌套表算第二张表Merged ranges are not expanded and covered positions produce no value; a nested table counts as the second table
  • 值在中间那步全是字符串，是否还原成数字由最后一步那三条规则决定：`1,234.50`、`¥100`、`45%`、`+33` 都不是十进制形状，留在文本Values are strings in the middle step and the final rule of three decides whether one comes back: `1,234.50`, `¥100`, `45%` and `+33` are not decimal-shaped and stay text
  • 本扩展写的 `.docx` 用的是 altChunk 容器，读回时会走恢复那一条路；用其他编辑器写的文档则看它自己的表格结构能否被 mammoth 认出The `.docx` files this extension writes carry an altChunk container and are read back through the recovery path; documents from other editors depend on whether mammoth recognises their table structure

实操提示Working with it

  • 只要一份文本表格：Word→CSV 是同一条链的前三步，产物是带 BOM 的 CSVFor a text table only: Word to CSV is the first three steps of this chain, ending in a BOM’d CSV
  • 要一份读起来像原文档的：Word→PDF、Word→HTML 或 Word→MarkdownFor something that reads like the document: Word to PDF, HTML or Markdown, which carry its structure and text
  • 只想读回值不要类型判断：Word→JSON，那里值全是字符串、结构按 `<h2>` 分组For values without any typing decision: Word to JSON, where everything is a string and grouping follows the `<h2>` text

常见问题Questions people actually ask

为什么我的 Word 表转成 Excel 后没有公式与格式？Why did my Word table come out with no formulas or formatting?

因为这条链搬运的是格子里的值：Word 表格里的内容被读成文字，再以「值是否逐字节回得来」决定要不要还成数字。文档里的样式、条件格式与计算结果都不是它的取数对象——它交付的是一张可算的数据表，不是一份排版副本。Because this chain carries values: the cells are read as text, and a number type returns only where the bytes round-trip. Styles, conditional formatting and computed results in the document are not what it extracts — what arrives is cell values, not a copy of the layout.

编号前面的零会丢吗？Do leading zeros in my ids survive?

不会。`00424` 与 16 位账号都留在文本形态并被钉住文本格式（写出的那一格用内置格式号 49），所以那一格存下来的就是文本形态的值。代价是那些格子里存的是字符而不是数值；这是本项目在「保住编号」与「让它成数」之间刻意选的前者。No. `00424` and a 16-digit identifier stay text and are pinned to a text format (the written cell uses the built-in format id 49), so what is stored there is text, not a number. The price is that those cells hold characters rather than a numeric value; that is the trade this project deliberately takes in favour of keeping identifiers intact.

两份表格能分别落到两个 sheet 吗？Can two tables land on two worksheets?

不能。这条链一次吃得下一张表：多张表在中间那步是分组对象，CSV 那步不接受；而写工作簿那步读的也只有一份 CSV。要两份，请把两张表分成两个文档各转一次，各自得到一份工作簿。Not on this route: it eats one table at a time, since several become a grouped object that the CSV step rejects, and the writer reads a single CSV anyway. Split the tables into two documents and convert each; you then have one workbook per table.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
